title: Faint Lavender Scent, Pretty Lavender Color--Good for Home Decor, Not Aromatherapy
text:
Faint Lavender Scent, Pretty Lavender Color--Good for Home Decor, Not Aromatherapy. These DII Z02076 HIGHLY SCENTED TEALIGHT CANDLES (36 Tealights, 1.5x0.63, Lavender Blossom) smell like lavender when you open the package, but they produce only the faintest of lavender scents when they’re burning. It’s disappointing not to get the expected lavender fragrance (which I love).

However, the tealights do burn for a long, long time, and they’re colored a pretty pale lavender. Thus they’re nice for home or party decor, if not for aromatherapy.
